# bitcoin-ui-react

> React component library for Bitcoin wallet UIs — amounts, addresses, seed phrases, and transaction displays with built-in formatting, animation, and accessibility.

## Install

```sh
npm install bitcoin-ui-react
```

Peer dependencies: `react >=18`, `react-dom >=18`.

## Components

- [BTCAmount](https://github.com/stefanoTron/bitcoin-ui-react/blob/main/src/components/BTCAmount/BTCAmount.tsx): Formatted BTC display with grouped decimals and spring animation
- [BTCInput](https://github.com/stefanoTron/bitcoin-ui-react/blob/main/src/components/BTCInput/BTCInput.tsx): Controlled BTC input with smart cursor management
- [AddressDisplay](https://github.com/stefanoTron/bitcoin-ui-react/blob/main/src/components/AddressDisplay/AddressDisplay.tsx): Truncated Bitcoin address with copy-to-clipboard
- [TransactionAmount](https://github.com/stefanoTron/bitcoin-ui-react/blob/main/src/components/TransactionAmount/TransactionAmount.tsx): Signed, colored transaction amount (wraps BTCAmount)
- [ConfirmationBadge](https://github.com/stefanoTron/bitcoin-ui-react/blob/main/src/components/ConfirmationBadge/ConfirmationBadge.tsx): Three-state confirmation indicator (unconfirmed/confirming/confirmed)
- [BalanceDisplay](https://github.com/stefanoTron/bitcoin-ui-react/blob/main/src/components/BalanceDisplay/BalanceDisplay.tsx): BTC/sats toggle display with tap-to-switch
- [SeedPhraseInput](https://github.com/stefanoTron/bitcoin-ui-react/blob/main/src/components/SeedPhraseInput/SeedPhraseInput.tsx): 12/24-word seed phrase entry with autocomplete and paste support
- [BitcoinIcon](https://github.com/stefanoTron/bitcoin-ui-react/blob/main/src/icons/BitcoinIcon/BitcoinIcon.tsx): Bitcoin (₿) SVG icon
- [SatsIcon](https://github.com/stefanoTron/bitcoin-ui-react/blob/main/src/icons/SatsIcon/SatsIcon.tsx): Satoshi SVG icon

## Utilities

- `clampSats(value)`: Clamp a number to the valid satoshi range (0–2,100,000,000,000,000)
- `MAX_SATS`: Maximum satoshi constant

## Tree-shaking

The library is fully tree-shakeable. SeedPhraseInput (which includes wordlist data) is available via a separate entry point:

```ts
import { SeedPhraseInput } from "bitcoin-ui-react/seed-phrase";
```

## Theming

All color defaults use CSS custom properties with fallbacks. Set them on any ancestor element:

| Token | Fallback | Used in |
|-------|----------|---------|
| `--btc-ui-color-inactive` | `#999999` | BTCAmount, BTCInput, AddressDisplay, BalanceDisplay, TransactionAmount |
| `--btc-ui-color-positive` | `#22c55e` | TransactionAmount, ConfirmationBadge |
| `--btc-ui-color-negative` | `#ef4444` | TransactionAmount, ConfirmationBadge |
| `--btc-ui-color-warning` | `#f59e0b` | ConfirmationBadge |
| `--btc-ui-color-brand` | `#f7931a` | BitcoinIcon |
| `--btc-ui-color-border` | `#ccc` | SeedPhraseInput |
| `--btc-ui-color-surface` | `#fff` | SeedPhraseInput |
| `--btc-ui-color-on-surface` | `#000` | SeedPhraseInput |

Explicit props always override CSS variables.

## Conventions

- All components accept `className` and `style` props for customization
- Amounts are always in satoshis (number)
- No CSS files — inline styles only
- Only runtime dependency: `motion` (for spring animations)
- TypeScript-first with exported prop types for every component
